title: Financing Certificate Platform for a Berlin Real Estate Service
excerpt: A platform for finanzierungszertifikat.com with a public site, a guided financing application, an advisor dashboard and a PDF certificate. Buyers use it to show agents and sellers that they have prepared the financing for a specific property.

signature.title: From a short application to a signed certificate
signature.body: Buyers complete a short full-screen application with a purchase-cost summary they can edit. An advisor reviews each application in the dashboard and issues the certificate as a signed PDF. The design stays calm on purpose, with no decorative motion.

challenge: The team behind finanzierungszertifikat.com wanted to issue financing certificates for a specific property to home buyers in Germany. The certificate shows agents and sellers that the buyer has prepared the financing and, in the banks' view, can afford the price. It is not a binding loan commitment, which only the lending bank can give. Until then, the way from enquiry to certificate ran by hand.
solution: webvise built a full-stack platform that keeps the application, the review and the certificate apart. Buyers complete a guided application in ten steps, covering the property, purchase costs, income, equity and existing loans, and confirm their email address. An OHYP advisor reviews each request in the dashboard and settles open questions and the required proof. Only then does the advisor create the certificate as a PDF with the property, the price and a signature. The platform uses tRPC for end-to-end type safety, PostgreSQL for the data and Better Auth for advisor sign-in.
results: Public site in German and English
Guided financing application in full screen
Purchase-cost summary the buyer can edit
Advisor dashboard for the full request lifecycle
Certificate issued as a signed PDF after review

testimonial.quote: webvise delivered a production-ready platform that exceeded our expectations. The automated certificate flow and the conversion-optimized funnel have become core to how we operate. Reliable, fast, and always thinking ahead.
testimonial.author: Richard Heinbach
